notes.title: Update 0.34 is live! Arcade mode is here!
notes.content:
Hello!

Version 0.34 is already on Steam and it includes the following major updates:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30034093/880a002f8fbc6fc2a21ba301396debcbfcd65d94.png[/img]

[h1]Arcade mode[/h1]
[b]Arcade mode (sandbox) is now available![/b] New Arcade Mode will allow you to fight waves of enemies in randomly generated Space Rifts. 
It’s just the first version and we will develop in future releases.
Have fun!

[h1]Game Settings screen [/h1]
To support arcade mode, we have implemented Game Settings screen:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30034093/875c9f25dd09158da1e012c8f32925394fc8d3ab.png[/img]

[h1]Balancing[/h1]
Normal, Hard, Veteran & Ace difficulty levels are rebalanced to be easier.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Development status update 17-FEB-2018
notes.content:
Hello!

Our regular update on status and plans of the game development.

[h1][b]ALREADY RELEASED[/b][/h1]
Let's start with what has already been implemented:
[list]
    [*][b]Balance.[/b] Balancing of the game was significantly reworked, improved and released on 22-JAN-2018. See  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/596740/announcements/detail/1655504439004331175]Update 0.33.00.00 announcement[/url] for more details.
    [*][b]Gamepad support.[/b] Gamepad support including full ship control and object interaction has been implemented. To interact with the main menu and in-game menu you need to use a mouse. See [url=http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791459555501/announcements/detail/1662261101865935374]Update 0.33.01.02 announcement[/url] for more details.
    [*][b]A number of improvements and fixes.[/b] We hear you! And we do our best to make Origin Space better. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791459555501/announcements/detail/2912011357798298518]Update 0.33.05.02[/url] brings a number of improvements and fixes based on your feedback. and 
[/list]
[h1][b]DEVELOPMENT PLANS[/b][/h1]
[u]Our reviewed and updated development priorities are as follows:[/u]

[h1]Sandbox mode[/h1]
A sandbox mode will allow players to travel around the game world without bounds of the campaign story. We expect to release this feature about [b]March 12, 2018[/b].

[h1]Online cooperative mode[/h1]
We plan to release a version with online cooperative mode support in early April 2018.

[h1][i]Engineer[/i] player class & Crafting[/h1]
Among the priorities of future development we see the following: 
[list]
    [*]To add one more player class [i]Engineer[/i].
    [*]To implement crafting of items.
[/list]

Hello!

Yesterday we released update 0.33.05.01. 
Based on your feedback we did some improvements and ...

[b]Update 0.33.05.02 is available on Steam now![/b]

Bellow is detailed release notes.

[h1]Added[/h1]
[list]
    [*]GamePad controls implemented
    [*] [i]‘I’[/i] button in inventory now opens a window with various secondary stats

[h1]Fixed[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Various scout ability visuals improvement (Charge Integrator, Guided Charge, Accelerator Unit, Hi EnergyBlast, Stasis Field, etc.)
    [*]Friendly NPCs now open portals before despawning
    [*]Active Event pointers sometimes disappeared
    [*]Various random crashes in crafting interface
    [*]Repair cost has been reduced
    [*]Warehouse upgrade costs now correctly displayed
    [*]Ship HP are now restored on levelup
    [*]Texture problems in the Curator encounter are fixed
    [*]Ship turning was not working after respawning on checkpoint
    [*]Boarding ability was not applying it effect correctly
    [*]Shader on wayfarer ships shield was incorrectly solid
    [*]Main Menu Buttons now correctly have focus
    [*]Fixed localization in [i]Hierarch[/i] quest objectives and various other English and Russian localization fixes
    [*]Quest Available Icon now stays visible on NPC if it had more than one quest available
    [*]Drops can now be looted with mouse clicks
    [*][i]‘Nothing Extra’[/i] ability was incorrectly increasing damage ten times more than expected
    [*]Lightning abilities graphics was changed to be more lightning-like
[/list]

notes.title: Development status update 26-JAN-2018
notes.content:
Hello!

Our regular update on status and plans of the game development.

[h1][b]Released[/b]: Balance improvement[/h1]
Balancing of the game was significantly reworked, improved and released on 22-JAN-2018. See  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/596740/announcements/detail/1655504439004331175]Update 0.33.00.00 announce[/url] for more details.
It was just fist iteration of balance improvement. Based on players' feedback we plan to continue work on developing the balance of the game.

[h1][b]Upcoming release[/b]: Gamepad support[/h1]
Gamepad support in accordance with Steam Partial Controller Support scheduled to release on  [b]02-FEB-2018[/b]. It will include full ship control and object interaction, but interface interactions (like store, inventory, etc.) will still require using of mouse. 

[u]Based on your feedback and wishes, we have reviewed and updated our development priorities in the following way.[/u]

[h1]Sandbox mode[/h1]
A sandbox mode will allow players to travel around the game world without bounds of the campaign story. We expect to release a sandbox mode in the first half of March 2018.

[h1]Online cooperative mode[/h1]
We plan to release a version with online cooperative mode support in early April 2018.

[h1][i]Engineer[/i] player class & Crafting[/h1]
One more player class [i]Engineer[/i] will be added. Crafting of items will be implemented.

notes.title: New: Update 0.33.00.00 is on Steam
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30034093/0e12e6f408cf7b7d74fdf350ff370dd9216288aa.jpg[/img]

Hello!

Update 0.33.00.00 has been released and available on Store now. The update includes the following:

[h1]Balancing[/h1]
As we [url=http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791459555501/announcements/detail/1596957009823096901]promised[/url] earlier based on your feedback, we have significantly reworked and improved balancing of the game. In comparison with versions before this update, you should expect the following changes in your experience:
[list]
    [*]Levels from 1 to 10 (approximately) - minor changes from previous version
    [*]Levels from 11 to 35 (approximately) - difficulty will gradually increase as the level increases 
    [*]Levels over 35 - significant increase of difficulty 
[/list]
[b]Note![/b] For existing characters it may be a good idea to upgrade items (e.g. by visiting the store) to make sure you are prepared for battles in conditions of reworked balance.

Certainly it is just [u]fist iteration of balance improvement[/u]. Based on your feedback we plan to continue work on developing the balance of the game and release more updates.

[h1]Other[/h1]
Some minor fixes.
